children: Ben Herman is the Founder of Aspen Search, the premier executive search firm for quantitative trading and technology talent. With over two decades of experience in recruiting, Ben has built a reputation as one of the most knowledgeable and results-driven talent partners in the industry.

Ben started his first executive search firm at 21 and never looked back. Over his career, he has personally billed $4.6M in a single year, generated over $150M in revenue from his first business, raised $96M from top-tier investors including Sequoia Capital, and angel invested in four unicorn companies. He has placed over 200 engineers and researchers at some of the most prestigious firms in quantitative finance, including Jane Street, Hudson River Trading, Two Sigma, PDT Partners, Citadel, and Headlands Technologies.

Today, Ben leads Aspen Search — formerly Herman Search — where he and his team focus on sourcing elite engineering, research, and AI talent for the world's top quantitative trading firms and VC-backed startups. His approach is built on deep relationships, radical honesty, and a genuine passion for connecting exceptional people with the right opportunities.
Outside of work, Ben is a proud dad of four, a devoted husband, and an avid collector of trading cards and sports memorabilia.

children: As a member of Aspen's founding recruiting team, Tyler has spent the last seven years helping build teams at some of the most respected firms in Big Tech and quantitative finance. From elite software engineers and machine learning researchers to technical leaders and quantitative talent, he has partnered with industry-leading organizations to bring exceptional people to already exceptional teams.

Known for his straightforward Southern California communication style, Tyler believes the best recruiting relationships are built on honesty. He'll tell you when you're doing everything right, when you're making a mistake, and when there's a better path forward. Candidates and clients alike value him not just as a recruiter, but as a trusted advisor who provides candid feedback, market insight, and long-term perspective.

While much of the recruiting industry is focused on the next transaction, Tyler focuses on building relationships that last. His goal isn't simply to fill a role; it's to become the person people call when they're evaluating a career move, building a team, or looking for a trusted perspective on the market.
Whether you're hiring world-class talent or exploring your next opportunity, Tyler believes great outcomes start with great relationships.

Lira is known for her relationship-driven approach and believes the best recruiting happens when people are treated as long-term partners, not transactions. Her focus is on building genuine relationships, understanding what motivates people, and helping them find opportunities that align with their goals and ambitions.

children: Mike brings more than 15 years of technical recruiting experience, partnering with high-growth technology companies to identify and attract specialized engineering, research, and technical leadership talent. His work has included building technical leadership teams at Robinhood, research leadership at Cruise, and supporting Amazon’s most ambitious early-stage initiatives across AI, robotics, and autonomous systems. He has since specialized in partnering with frontier AI labs and venture-backed startups, helping founders and technical leaders build foundational teams across AI/ML Research and engineering. His work continues to focus on specialized talent for companies building at the earliest and most consequential stages of emerging technology.

children: Kunal Batra is a founding team member at Aspen, where he specializes in placing elite quantitative engineers and researchers with top-tier trading firms and select high-growth startups. He brings a rare combination of deep industry relationships and data-driven insight to every search — giving candidates a genuine edge throughout the interview process.

Before Aspen, Kunal spent over three years at Long Ridge Partners building his expertise in quant and hedge fund talent. To date, he has completed more than 50 successful placements across the quant finance space, with a track record that speaks to both his network and his ability to match exceptional people with the right opportunities.
Kunal holds a B.S. in Business and Communications from Penn State. Outside of work, he's an avid sports fan, concert-goer, and active trader across equities, futures, and crypto.

6c.className: order-1 flex flex-col gap-40 bg-grey px-12 py-20 text-black lg:order-2 lg:px-20

children: Mario began his career on the buy side as a Trading Analyst at First Eagle Investment Management, where he supported market research and trade execution for the Global Value team of portfolio managers overseeing approximately $90 billion in assets. He later transitioned into specialized quantitative research and trading recruitment, focusing on systematic strategies, statistical arbitrage, high-frequency alpha, and options automated market making. He built his expertise at firms including Options Group and Carrington Fox before joining Aspen Search. Mario holds a double major in Economics and Psychology from Rutgers University

6d.className: order-1 flex flex-col gap-40 bg-grey px-12 py-20 text-black lg:order-2 lg:px-20

children: Chris is a Senior Recruiter with over 12 years of experience in recruiting. He started at an agency in Seattle focused on startups, then landed his first big tech job at Facebook. He recruited E7 engineers across both NYC and Seattle and went on to work with mid to late stage startups where he has recruited for all types of roles.

That journey eventually led him to a chance introduction to industry legend Ben Herman, who pulled him into the quant trading world. Now a Senior Recruiter at Aspen Search, Chris focuses exclusively on top quant trading firms globally. He brings a deep, firsthand relationship with firms like EQR and a track record of successful placements there.
His approach is simple: honesty and transparency above all. He gives real feedback and genuinely tries to add value, not just fill seats.
Based in Portland, hiring for NYC. He likes all the regular PNW stuff like backpacking, food carts, and musical theatre.

children: Aspen Search ("we", "us", "our") is a boutique executive search firm. This policy explains the limited information we handle when you visit our website or get in touch, how we use it, and the choices you have. We have built this site to be privacy-friendly by default.
Aspen Search is the data controller for any personal information handled through this website. If you have a question about this policy or the data we hold, contact us at

This website does not use cookies. We set no advertising, tracking, or marketing cookies, we do not build profiles of visitors, and we do not track you across other sites. Because there are no cookies, there is no cookie banner to manage.

We use Umami, a privacy-focused analytics tool, to understand how the site is used. Umami collects only anonymous, aggregated data such as page views and broad, country-level location, and it uses no cookies. It does not collect personal information and does not track individuals across websites.

If you share your CV through our contact form, you can upload a document (PDF, DOC, or TXT). These files are stored securely on Vercel Blob storage and are used solely for recruitment and related HR purposes, such as assessing your suitability for relevant roles and progressing your application.

Files in our temporary storage are retained for 30 days and are then automatically and permanently deleted from it. Where your application is relevant to a current or future search, we may download and keep a copy for as long as is necessary for recruitment and related HR purposes. We also retain a basic record of each submission, such as the original filename and upload date, as an audit trail.

When you email us or use the contact options on this site, we receive the details you choose to share, such as your name and email address, so that we can respond and, where relevant, discuss opportunities with you. We do not sell your personal information.
You can ask us to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you, or to stop contacting you, at any time. To make a request, email
We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page, with the "Last updated" date above revised accordingly. We encourage you to review it periodically.

children: Aspen Search was founded on a simple observation: the best quantitative researchers and engineers don't apply to jobs. They get one shot every few years to make a move, and they want that conversation to be with someone who actually understands the work — the systems, the strategies, the tradeoffs, and the difference between a fund that will sharpen them and one that will stall them.

That's the bar we hold ourselves to. We've spent nearly two decades inside the hiring rooms of the top systematic firms and the venture-backed teams competing for the same minds. We don't pitch roles. We have honest conversations about where someone should spend the next five years of their career — and we're often the reason it's the right call.
